text: A running key is a long text written under the message, one letter per place. Here the text is the sculpture itself: the carved table by rows or columns, the Morse phrases, and the four ciphertexts as one panel, each forwards and backwards.
At every starting point, each known place needs one particular key letter. Drawn for the table by rows under one way of using it, at the best of 781 starts: 4 of 24.
162,912 trials across all sources, starts and 24 ways of using the table: none comes within three of the 24.
